question: Which ministry launched the SMILE Scheme on 12th February 2022?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The answer is the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• SMILE stands for **Support for Marginalized Individuals for livelihood and Enterprise.**
 
• The Smile Scheme is launched by the union minister of Social justice and Empowerment, Dr. Virendra Singh
